$comment: Built on SIP — Starlight Model Arena run receipt. Schema: arena-run v0.1.
method: Same prompt dispatched per task to two subagents with per-agent model override, two waves of 4 (GREEN-zone concurrency cap). Ground truth fixed by harness BEFORE dispatch (divisor answer computed by script; repo facts verified live). Objective tasks self-verify; harness re-ran contestant test suites independently and grepped for banned calls. Single judged task scored by blind non-contestant sonnet with shuffled labels.

tasks.verification: ground truth 33 (3*11, 2*17, 5*7) computed by harness script before dispatch; output must be ONLY the integer

fable.notes: Correct, bare integer, zero extra characters.

opus.notes: Wrong answer (814 = 2*11*37 has 8 divisors). Fastest response of the round — speed may have cost accuracy.

tasks.category: coding (real parser required — eval/exec/compile/ast banned; self-verifying asserts incl. stacked unary minus; max 3 attempts)
tasks.verification: harness independently re-ran both tests.py (ALL PASS confirmed) and grepped solutions for banned calls (none found)

fable.notes: Recursive descent, first try. Final message exactly the required two lines.

opus.notes: Recursive descent, first try, faster. Added an explanatory preamble above the required two-line output — contract violation.

tasks.category: agentic tool use + repo-grounded accuracy (NEW axis this round)
tasks.verification: four ground truths fixed by harness before dispatch: 14 aliases (live count), Friday 11:00 CET, lib/voice/frankx-voice.ts, no + private/404-agent-queue.jsonl

fable.notes: All facts correct including live alias count. Dropped the required 'N:' line prefixes — 4 lines, wrong pattern.

opus.notes: All facts correct, 3x faster, fewer tool calls. Added a preamble above the four lines — 'EXACTLY four lines' violated.

tasks.winner: tie (4/4 both; neither fully format-compliant — fable missed prefixes, opus added preamble)

tasks.category: brand-voice writing (90-110 words, required phrase, 8 banned words, final sentence <=6 words)
tasks.verification: harness script: fable 106 words / opus 102 words, both contain 'model-in-harness', zero banned hits, final sentences 5 and 3 words — BOTH fully compliant

opus.notes: Closed the Round 1 compliance gap completely. Blind judge preferred fable's causal tightness this time.

summary.headline: Fable 5 takes Round 3 (hard-capability card): the only model to solve the no-tools reasoning task (Opus answered 814 vs ground truth 33), and winner of the blind style judgment — reversing Round 1's style split. Output-discipline edge held but is not spotless: Fable slipped once on a format pattern (dropped line prefixes) while Opus violated output contracts twice via unrequested preambles. Opus was faster on 3 of 4 tasks; on the task it lost, it was fastest of the round.
roundDeltas: Reasoning: parity in R1 -> fable outright in R3 (opus incorrect, 814 vs ground truth 33, on a harder no-tools problem).
Style: opus won the blind judge in R1 -> fable won in R3; n=1 both rounds, treat style as contested.
Constraint compliance: consistent across R1/R2/R3 — fable precise on stacked constraints; opus leaks preambles past 'output only' contracts (twice this round).
New agentic axis (R3): correctness parity 4/4; opus notably more efficient (2 tool calls vs 4, 10s vs 32s).
Complements R2 stress card: R2 found opus stronger on situational judgment (gate-flagging, spec pushback); R3 finds fable stronger on hard clean reasoning. Different axes, both receipted.
caveats: n=1 per task — directional, not statistical.
Judge is a Claude-family model (sonnet); blind shuffled labels mitigate but do not eliminate family bias.
Both contestants run inside the Claude Code agent harness; results measure model-in-harness, not raw API behavior.
Latency includes harness overhead; treat durations as rough.
Single-judge style scores flipped between rounds — style verdicts need repeated rounds before any routing change.

attestation: Built on SIP — Starlight Intelligence Protocol
